summary: Site 105 has one Metrocount piezo counter (2011-2026) with a steady, well-balanced record; the automatic fixes already handle the long 2014-03 to 2015-07 all-zero outage and several short outages, and data is absent from Oct 2021 to Jul 2022. From 15 to 28 Feb 2013, direction 32 also counted the North East bikes (it was at or above direction 31 in almost every slot), so those days are set missing, as is 2018-04-06 with its implausible test-like burst. Several single-direction zero_outage fixes fell on wet days when the other direction was also nearly empty, so those are restored.
